Chapter 268 - 268 Upgrade The Eyes Of Truth; Join Them!

Chapter 268 - 268 Upgrade the Eyes of Truth; Join Them!

268 Upgrade the Eyes of Truth; Join Them!

Then, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on the double skill card and the skill level upgrade card.

[Double skill card: You can double the ability of a certain skill for an hour. You’ll possess more powerful skills and display more charm.]

[Skill level upgrade card: You can upgrade a skill level. Mastering even more profound skills will make you more fascinating.]

Lin Fan was very familiar with these two cards.

It was because he had used them before.

Even before Lin Fan opened the 15,721 red packets, he already had two double skill cards and one skill level upgrade card.

The double skill card had a time limit, so Lin Fan had not used it yet.

As for the skill level upgrade card, he only had one for the time being. He wanted to save it for when he needed it and be more selective with the skill he chose so as to be prepared.

Now, he could use one of them.

Hence, Lin Fan turned his attention back to the system.

[Skills: Professional Driving Skills, Charming Aura (5% chance of triggering love at first sight, unforgettable memory), Violent Aesthetics, Drinking Gentleman, Professor-Level Mathematics Experience, Eyes of Truth…]

After some consideration, Lin Fan locked onto the Eyes of Truth.

[Do you want to upgrade the level of Eyes of Truth?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Upgrade successful! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the Eyes of True Sight.]

[Eyes of True Sight: Possesses all the abilities of the Eyes of Truth. In addition, you can see the specific origin of the object. Seeing the origin of an object lets you grasp things that ordinary people don’t know. You get to display amazing charm.]

Eyes of True Sight?

See the origin of the object?

Lin Fan could not help but feel puzzled. He used the Eyes of True Sight on the marble table in front of him.

In an instant, he saw a slab of marble getting discovered, processed, polished, and carved…The entire process was like a movie scene, appearing very clearly in Lin Fan’s mind.

Seeing this…

Even Lin Fan could not help but reveal a look of shock.

Then, he used the Eyes of True Sight on the cup on the table, and then the clock on the wall…

This feeling… It was as if these things were all personally made by Lin Fan. It was incomparably magical.

Lin Fan could not help but praise, “This skill level upgrade card is pretty good!”

Then, his gaze fell on Expert-Level Dancing Technique.

[Expert-Level Dancing Technique: Master all kinds of dancing techniques. You can be all-powerful on the stage and show off your charm.]

Dance?

Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction.

“One yuan critical hit card: After spending one yuan, you’ll receive a reward of 100 million yuan.]

Lin Fan only glanced at it casually and did not take it to heart.

All in all…

This concert allowed Lin Fan to obtain 5% of the shares of Little Tanuki Group, a high-end office building worth five billion, a large entertainment company, two land certificates for a plot of land up to 10,000 square meters, Expert-Level Dancing Technique, and a one yuan critical hit card…

At the same time, it raised the system’s level to level 7. Furthermore, Lin Fan’s Eyes of Truth became the Eyes of True Sight.

On the other hand, Lin Fan had only spent 149 million yuan to organize this concert!

This was definitely a great harvest!

At this moment, a crisp bell rang outside.

A man in a white shirt was standing outside the door with high-end lunch boxes in his hand.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan opened the door.

“Sir, this is the breakfast you ordered,” the man said respectfully.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

The man bowed slightly and said, “Enjoy your meal.”

Whether it was his tone or his service attitude, they were all very good.

Ling Rou seemed to have heard the noise outside. She dragged her tired body and slowly walked out.

Lin Fan said, “You’re up? Since breakfast has arrived, let’s eat together.”

“Alright…” Ling Rou replied.

Then, she and Lin Fan sat down at the dining table and opened the high-end lunch boxes.

When she saw the delicious food in the lunch box, Ling Rou was slightly stunned.

Sea urchin egg, big scallops, bird’s nest porridge, seafood porridge, truffle egg tart, caviar cake, and beef…

Ling Rou could not help but say, “This… How much is this breakfast?”

“About 30,000,” Lin Fan replied casually.

More than 30,000 yuan… for breakfast?

Even though Ling Rou already knew that Lin Fan was rich, she could not help but widen her eyes.

One had to know…

Her monthly food expenses were only 3,000 yuan.

In other words, today’s breakfast… was almost a year’s worth of food?

Lin Fan did not care about Ling Rou’s surprise. He personally scooped a bowl of bird’s nest porridge and handed it to Ling Rou, “You’re still a little weak. Drink something light to warm yourself up first…”

“Alright… Alright,” Ling Rou stuttered.

When she drank the first mouthful of porridge, Ling Rou could not help but exclaim, “It’s delicious!”

Lin Fan smiled. “If you like it, then have more.”

“Yes, yes!” Ling Rou said.

This breakfast was definitely the most Ling Rou had ever eaten.

One had to know…

Lin Fan had ordered enough for three men.

In the end, everything was finished.

Ling Rou named it Operation Disc.

The lunch boxes were empty, and Ling Rou’s stomach became round.

At this moment, Ling Rou’s phone rang again.

“Hello, Ms. Ling. I’m Li Xiaofei, the general manager of Dafang Entertainment.” A middle-aged woman’s voice came from the phone.

Ling Rou had already answered several similar calls.

It could be said that she already had some experience.

When she answered the call, she was no longer as nervous as before. She seemed much more relaxed and indifferent.

“Hello, Manager Li,” Ling Rou said.

“Dafang Entertainment is very optimistic about you, Ms. Ling…” Li Xiaofei said.

Like the representatives of the previous companies, she listed out a lot of conditions.

“Thank you for your offer, but I’d like to think about this matter carefully.”

Li Xiaofei said, “Yes, this really needs to be considered… However, Ms. Ling, Dafang Entertainment can definitely give you the best resources…”

The two of them chatted for a while before hanging up.

Ling Rou opened her phone’s reminder and slowly wrote down the name of Dafang Entertainment as well as the general remuneration and relevant contacts.

Then, Ling Rou looked at the names of the companies and their benefits. She was lost in thought.

“You haven’t decided which company to choose yet?” Lin Fan asked.

Ling Rou shook her head and said, “No…”

“What do you think of Xin Mei Entertainment?” Lin Fan asked.

“Xin Mei Entertainment is one of the top three entertainment companies in Hua Nation! Its celebrities consist of A-list movie stars and singers who occupy almost a quarter of Hua Nation’s market. They’re also the company I want to work for the most, but they didn’t call me…” Ling Rou said helplessly.

Lin Fan said, “Then join them.”

“Huh?”
